translation:
Um, I'm really not good with scary stories and
that sort of stuff…
Oh, well that's perfect then, right?

This is the perfect opportunity to conquer
your fears!

Things are only scary if you think they're
scary.

Ghosts and monsters—they haunt those who
fear them.

In other words—it's all about having a
fighting spirit!

Not to mention, even though we aren't able to
see or touch them…

…they're allowed to screw with us however
they please! How unfair is that?!

But I'm sure that if we just have confidence,
everything will work out somehow.
Are you sure that's going to work…?
Completely. There's not a doubt in my mind!
